title: Stage of equality for two descended morphisms
statement: Fix a directed index set $I$, an inverse system of schemes $(S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ with affine transition morphisms, and an identification $S=\varprojlim_{\lambda\in I}S_\lambda$; fix $\lambda_0\in I$ with $S_{\lambda_0}$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and use [def-nagata-basechanged-system] for the base changes $X_\lambda,X,Y_\lambda,Y$ ($\lambda\geq\lambda_0$). Let $X_{\lambda_0}$ and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ be schemes of finite presentation over $S_{\lambda_0}$ (so both are qcqs, and each $X_\lambda$, being affine over $X_{\lambda_0}$, is qcqs), and let $\varphi_{\lambda_0},\psi_{\lambda_0}:X_{\lambda_0}\to Y_{\lambda_0}$ be morphisms over $S_{\lambda_0}$ with equal base change $X\to Y$. Choose a finite affine cover $\{T_j=\operatorname{Spec}R_j\}$ of $S_{\lambda_0}$ and, over it, a finite affine cover $\{V_{jk}=\operatorname{Spec}B_{jk}\}$ of $Y_{\lambda_0}$ with $V_{jk}$ mapping into $T_j$ and each $B_{jk}$ a finitely presented $R_j$-algebra; fix a finite set $G_{jk}\subseteq B_{jk}$ generating $B_{jk}$ as an $R_j$-algebra. For each $(j,k)$ put $W_1=\varphi_{\lambda_0}^{-1}(V_{jk})$ and $W_2=\psi_{\lambda_0}^{-1}(V_{jk})$; these are quasi-compact opens of $X_{\lambda_0}$ ($\varphi_{\lambda_0},\psi_{\lambda_0}$ are quasi-compact, since $X_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and $Y_{\lambda_0}$ quasi-separated), and their inverse images in $X$ are both the inverse image of $V_{jk}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S$ under the common base change, hence equal. Let $\lambda_{jk}=\lambda_{W_1=W_2}$ be the stage of [def-nagata-qc-open-equality-stage], applied with the scheme $X_{\lambda_0}$ (qcqs over $S_{\lambda_0}$) in the role of the scheme called $Y_{\lambda_0}$ there. Let $W_{i,\lambda_{jk}}$ be the inverse image of $W_i$ in $X_{\lambda_{jk}}$ and choose a finite affine open cover $\{U_{jkl}\}_l$ of $W_{1,\lambda_{jk}}\cap W_{2,\lambda_{jk}}$ (quasi-compact, as $X_{\lambda_{jk}}$ is qcqs); for $\mu\geq\lambda_{jk}$ let $U_{jkl,\mu}$ and $U^\infty_{jkl}$ be its inverse images in $X_\mu$ and in $X$. Each $U_{jkl,\mu}$ is affine (the transition $X_\mu\to X_{\lambda_{jk}}$ is a base change of the affine $S_\mu\to S_{\lambda_{jk}}$) and $U^\infty_{jkl}=\varprojlim_{\mu}U_{jkl,\mu}$ (fibre products commute with limits), so by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit] and uniqueness of limits $\Gamma(U^\infty_{jkl},\mathcal O)=\varinjlim_{\mu\geq\lambda_{jk}}\Gamma(U_{jkl,\mu},\mathcal O)$ as rings. For $b\in G_{jk}$ let $x,y\in\Gamma(U_{jkl},\mathcal O)$ be the pullbacks of $b$ along the two composites $U_{jkl}\to X_{\lambda_0}\to V_{jk}$ through $\varphi_{\lambda_0}$ and through $\psi_{\lambda_0}$ (both composites lie over $T_j$, so they pull back elements of $R_j$ equally, and no condition on $R_j$ is needed). Since $\varphi_{\lambda_0}$ and $\psi_{\lambda_0}$ have the same base change, $x$ and $y$ have the same image in $\Gamma(U^\infty_{jkl},\mathcal O)$; by clause (2) of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise], applied to the directed set $\{\mu\in I\mid\mu\geq\lambda_{jk}\}$, choose $\mu_{jklb}\geq\lambda_{jk}$ such that the images of $x$ and $y$ in $\Gamma(U_{jkl,\mu_{jklb}},\mathcal O)$ are equal. Let $F$ be the finite set consisting of $\lambda_0$, all $\lambda_{jk}$ and all $\mu_{jklb}$, and define $\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}=u(F)$ using [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound].

split_report.summary: Repaired the definition after the E/C4 return: X_{lambda_0} and Y_{lambda_0} are required to be of finite presentation over S_{lambda_0}; the construction now explicitly chooses a finite affine target cover, the selected quasi-compact-open equality stage for each chart, a finite affine cover of each common inverse image, and a finite-data stage for the induced ring maps, then applies the selected finite upper bound. Added def-nagata-basechanged-system as the setup dependency. No child nodes or proof steps are required, and Mathlib searches found only broader inverse-limit results.
